name: smartfarm-auto-start-crop-worker
description: Standalone Node.js worker for SmartFarm Pro 'Auto start new crop': every cycle it calls dbo.AutoStartCrop_CreatePending (create the waiting crop once rest days are over) and dbo.AutoStartCrop_GateCheck (start it once a CKALE is online and the day's total sampling > 100). All rules live in those two SPs - see README.md.
